decisions.reason: After two years on the market with a dedicated presentation and strong fit to the core business, it is likely meeting or staying close enough to aspiration levels that management would retain it.

The sensor suite extends established capabilities into a growing adjacent need and its continued dedicated visibility suggests results that remain acceptable relative to aspiration despite uncertainty.

Because this LiDAR offering has remained only lightly commercialized since 2023 while newer strategic developments compete for the same specialist resources, management would likely judge it below aspiration and redeploy the resources.

As a newly launched radiation-hard camera line with its own market presentation and very close alignment with the firm's reliability-based value proposition, it would likely be given time under existing organizational slack.

The asteroid navigation and imaging camera is more niche and only tentatively commercialized, but its technological relatedness and exploratory value make continued retention more likely than immediate withdrawal.
